questions.q: The point (3, 5) is reflected in the line y = x. Find its image.
questions.why: Reflecting in y = x swaps the coordinates.

questions.q: The point (2, 1) is rotated 90° clockwise about the origin. Find its image.
questions.why: 90° clockwise about O maps (x, y) to (y, −x); (−1, 2) is anticlockwise.

questions.q: The point (3, −1) is enlarged with scale factor −2, centre the origin. Find its image.
questions.why: Multiply both coordinates by −2; the image is on the opposite side of the centre.

questions.q: What must you state to describe fully a single rotation?
questions.model: Rotation, the centre (as coordinates), the angle, and the direction (clockwise or anticlockwise)
